name: 🌻 Farm It! [BETA]
desc:
🌻 Welcome to Farm It! 🌻

How to play:
🌱 Build farmland, buy seeds and plant them
🌻 Harvest the crops, sell them or produce goods
👨‍🌾 Buy machines, hire workers and expand your farm
💸 Become the richest farmer on the planet!

⏰ Everything grows even when you are offline
⭐ Remember to like and favourite the game for more updates!

Inspired by Grow a Garden and Hay Day.
The game is still in beta. Bugs are expected and can be reported in the Beetroot Games group!
